
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- complex_iot.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- complex_iot.volt:6[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 0 must be HIGH during boot (pulled up by default). If driven LOW externally, the chip enters bootloader mode.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 2
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     pin button: PullUpInput = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- UNSAVED STORAGE -- complex_iot.volt:11[/yellow bold]

Storage variable `boot_count` is never saved, so it resets to its default on every boot.

 [dim]10 |[/dim] 
 [dim]11 |[/dim] storage boot_count: int = 0
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Call `storage.save("boot_count", boot_count)` after changing it.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- UNHANDLED FAILURE -- complex_iot.volt:49[/yellow bold]

`wifi.connect` has no fallback if it fails.

 [dim]48 |[/dim] setup {
 [dim]49 |[/dim]     wifi.connect("MyNet", "MyPass")
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Without one the program carries on offline. Add `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- UNHANDLED FAILURE -- complex_iot.volt:50[/yellow bold]

`mqtt.connect` has no fallback if it fails.

 [dim]49 |[/dim]     wifi.connect("MyNet", "MyPass")
 [dim]50 |[/dim]     mqtt.connect("mqtt://broker.local")
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Without one the program carries on offline. Add `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.[/cyan]
